text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Jingle be~lls♪ Jingle be~lls♪ 
Jingle all the way, HEY!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Oh what fun ha-han-han-haan! Wasshoi, 
wasshoi x2! 
――Aight, finished~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"My, this is quite a masterpiece of a snow 
sculpture. 
A reindeer and――hmm, what might this 
lavish pedestal be?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's "A Reindeer on a Festival Float."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"At least let them shoulder it... Well, 
maybe pulling it is more realistic? 
Still, this thing is huge. It's gotta be 
around 3 meters tall."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, with such delicate balance... won't 
it collapse any second now?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, I've got a Pre-1st Grade 
certification in Snow Sculpture Balance, 
ya know! 
Despite how it looks, the structural 
integrity is rock solid, see?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Hoh. 
――In that case, I shall inspect it 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph. How about that for durability...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. "Unsatisfactory."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah.
(KABOOOOM!)
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Secure everyone, nooooow!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief, all of you! When playing in 
the snow, please give 
due regard to safety! One wrong move could 
have caused a serious accident!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My apologies... We got a little carried 
away with our play, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Still, as a result, it served as a good 
stress test. 
We managed to prevent a disaster 
beforehand, so let's just say..."
(Ding-a-ling-ling~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"From the dorms... a group email? 
'Notice to the Joint Dorm Christmas Party 
Organizing Committee'... ?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"'Please ensure a fun Christmas party for 
the dorm residents spending the 
year-end at the academy'――............What 
in the world is this?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Did I not mention it? 
The 5 of us are this year's Christmas 
party organizers!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"............I see. 
Would you mind explaining how this came to 
be?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ehhh? You want the whole dramatic story, 
then~? 
――It all started 3 years ago..."

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text:
"'Waaah, SteGo~! I did a bad thing! 
I won the lottery to be on the joint dorm 
Christmas party organizing committee~~!!'"

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text:
"'I, like, wrote everyone's names down on 
the ghost leg lottery! 
It was just on a whim! Big Sis is gonna be 
so mad at meee~!'"

text_block_list.name: Stego
text_block_list.text:
"'Ah, it's fine, it's fine! Just let 'em 
do it! 
I'll give 'em a stern word myself, so go 
knock 'em dead!!'"

text_block_list.name: Golshi-chan
text_block_list.text:
"'Thanks, Daddy-o! I'll do my bestest! 
♡♡♡♡'"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ――And that's pretty much what happened.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You're clearly exaggerating, no matter 
how you look at it. 
At least show some sincerity and do a 
proper impression."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You mean to say... that's how we ended 
up on the organizing 
committee!? How utterly selfish...!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"What's your deal, Meno? Don't tell me 
you're planning to abandon Santa's 
duties!? 
You gonna disappoint all the good little 
kids! You fiend! You demon!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"How dare you――! Putting down others' 
names without permission is 
an unforgivable act! You ought to reflect 
on your actions first!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"..................Even so, we cannot 
simply abandon the duty, can we...? 
Since it has come to this, the five of us 
must carry out our mission properly."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"It's too much of a pain in the ass to 
whine about backing out now anyway. 
In short, all we gotta do is 'have fun and 
play around', right? Fine, count me in."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"......Very well. Work diligently, you 
lot, 
and craft a gathering befitting of my 
hosting."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"This is not Orfe-san's personal party, 
you know!? 
And you are a full-fledged committee 
member as well, so please do your job 
properly!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, please!! Take this seriously!! 
Put your best effort into managing this!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. This has turned into quite... an 
amusing situation, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, right, here's a letter for ya. 
SteGo said she's headin' out on a trip for 
a while."

'I expect one hell of a souvenir story 
from you.'

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"――――I see. 
So that's your game, Boss."
